notes.title: Worbital Content Update #4 - New Weapons, Fixes and Free Steam Weekend!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/55d9409864096760b463576e1ed13997ea183e33.png

Here comes the much anticipated fourth Worbital content update! And boy, do we have some stuff for you.

First and foremost, we did our best to fix the most essential bugs and issues that have been reported over the last months. Network issues, weapon bugs, visuals, balance - we fixed a whole bunch. Hopefully, this will make matches a lot smoother for many players.

Second - and most exciting, we added new weapons! Each of the factions gets one: Partycle Ball (Celestials), Bouncer (Lucid) and Waste Missile (Terrene).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/b0a8be17180876af64609649c811d822d1adc575.gif

See the full changelog for today’s update enclosed at the end of this announcement.

Consoles & Free Steam Weekend
As we’ve announced earlier, this Friday we are launching Worbital on PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch. At launch, cross-platform multiplayer will be functional for PC and Switch players. We’re also continuing work to connect players from the other platforms as well. The more the merrier!

In order to add yet more action for the coming days, Worbital has been approved for a free weekend on Steam! This will undoubtedly bring about a swarm of new players, in addition to the console folk. Gather your friends for some planet-busting action, starting Oct. 17th at 10:00am, lasting until Oct. 20th 1:00pm (PT).

That’s about it. What do you think of the new weapons? Let us know in the comments, on Twitter, Facebook or on our official Discord server.

Happy blasting!

notes.title: Worbital Price Reduced, Feature Update Coming!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/5b05ec94441e19f504427539eb45bedfc1d469dd.png

Citizens! Be prepared for the collapse. Of prices! Starting today, Worbital’s full Steam price is dropped to $12.99/€12.99. Now that it’s been over half a year, it seems fitting to try a lower price, so here we are. Hopefully, this brings Worbital to the hands of more players!

The same reduced price will also apply to the PS4, Xbox One and Nintendo Switch versions of the game. Oh yes, by the way, we are launching Worbital on PS4, Xbox One and Switch on October 18th. At launch, cross-platform multiplayer will be functional for PC and Switch players. You can check our blog announcement for more details.

We might be reaching out to the new players on other platforms, but we’re not leaving the PC players without some juicy new stuff! Next week, we’ll be putting out a fresh content update, bringing a couple of completely new weapons, and a few fixes. Stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33169128/ad26bcdd8d4a92a1f1e2d78af5c04d18c086ab87.gif

Have a guess on what the other new weapon might be? Share it with us in the comments! Or come to chat about it on our official Discord server.

notes.title: Worbital Content Update #3 - Extreme Campaign
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/b1f062221c6de76edf0d1b1d8593b699fd557b37.jpg

Update #3, here we go! Let’s get busy.

We noted comments about the campaign being too difficult and we took them seriously. It is now even more difficult!

Okay, now stay with us! The main campaign has been made significantly easier since the launch. However, for those players who like a special challenge, we are now adding a special, Extreme Campaign mode—go nuts! It contains all the same missions, except more difficult and with new endings and rewards.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/46c130287a2df9eee0c2553dfa87899d0648adf7.png

For those of you who enjoy playing with a gamepad: this other new feature will rock your world. We added controller vibration! Now every shot, hit or explosion will bring a real, tactile feel. If you see a barrage coming your way—make sure you’re buckled in.

Last but not least, we are expanding our intercultural reach. Worbital is now available in German language. Willkommen!

Worbital 1.07.6157 - March 21st, 2019

Features

Extreme Campaign!

A more difficult version of the campaign, unlocked for each faction after you finish their timeline. Includes new cosmetic rewards and ending images.

New Language: German
Controller Vibration

Fixes

Fixed a bug that may have caused the game to freeze after being paused
Starting an AI only match from the Alliance queue now properly starts a team match with 3 AIs
Fire/Ice moons are now assigned with the correct ratio in Fire & Ice
Ice solar flares caused by the Solaronite Gun now properly have their damage slightly reduced compared to their fire counterparts
AI is now better at defending against asteroids
Removed “Replace” button when highlighting empty planet sectors
Minor bug fixes
Minor text fixes

Adjustments

Added Vacuum Bomb to player loadout in Lucid Mission 03, for added asteroid fun
Changed the priorities of fund consumption in situations where you’re low and multiple structures are under construction. Instead of funds being distributed evenly, the first chosen structure is prioritised, making it less likely to accidentally slow down progress too much.



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/8937aa991a0d0c420346c8bd0337c203736007cc.jpg

We are also coming to play Worbital online tomorrow, March 22nd, at 3pm UTC. Come play with us!

If you already own Worbital, you can support us by leaving a review on Steam or on Metacritic. This really helps getting some more eyes on Worbital!

You can also follow us on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram.

notes.title: Worbital Content Update #2 - Keybindings
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/ad28af8fd5d157b27d7cea31434cbbae151a8b20.jpg

Time for the second content update. This week, we introduce a much needed feature to add more convenience to playing—keybindings.

Previously, you could navigate the solar system either with the default WASD or the arrow keys. Now it’s possible to rebind any keys in any way you like. This should make Worbital more accessible for different kinds of players, for example, left-handed players.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/890bd9fe121c4b86594ad5441c1cb577f9047780.png

We’ve also made some changes to the demo, to help demo-players get into matches. It is now possible to start an match against AIs only in the quickplay Chaos queue. Now, lack of players online shouldn’t stop you from getting a taste of cosmic chaos.

No new weapons this week, but we do have something tasty in store for you. Stay tuned!

Worbital 1.06.5986 - March 4th, 2019


Features

Keybindings for Keyboard & Mouse


Fixes

Fixed some issues that could cause derailed suns to be out of sync in online play
Merged lasers caused by AI no longer stick around after the weapons stop firing
Improved AIs defensive capabilities
Dreadnought can no longer warp through the sun
Fixed a bug with AIs Solar Laser that was caused when the satellite was destroyed
More fixes to the Match Timer position on various aspect ratios


Adjustments

Added the option to start a match in quickplay with AIs only, if no players have joined after a certain time period (this allows for AI only matches in the Demo as well)
Pressing on the right stick on controller still moves you to overview of the solar system, but no longer zooms in



As usual, please remember to leave us a Steam review! To support Worbital, you can also follow us on Facebook, Twitter or Instagram.

notes.title: Worbital Update #1 - Valentine's Day Special
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/a2c94c4f9be3bd4530aa3202d880796ddb466053.jpg

After a few patches, the time has come for a proper update. Today we bring you our special, sweet Valentine’s update.

You’ve probably got familiar with all the weapons in the Worbital arsenal by now, so we are adding a new one—Sentry Capsule. Once it hits an uninhabited planet, the capsule transforms into a stationed automatic turret gun which fires at the nearby enemies. Sentry Capsule is available to all factions.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/ba86148c77546ba1c812d44b337ee6a5b433c677.png

We also have several new outfits for the advisor characters. Each a perfect fit for a dreamy Valentine’s date! You can unlock the new items with Dark Matter and experiment to your taste. 

See the full update changelog below.

Worbital 1.04.5709 - February 13th, 2019

Features

A New Weapon

Sentry Capsule (All Factions): unpacks into an AI-controlled turret when hitting an uninhabited planet

New Outfits: Happy Valentine’s Day!

Suit, Suit Arms
Layered Dress
Warm Collar, Warm Shoulders, Animal Ears

A little extra Valentine’s Day something...


Fixes

Added extra checks to avoid network disconnects
AI’s aiming of non-gravity based weapon made a bit more sensible


Adjustments

Added “Worbital News” popup for Main Menu. It works as a simplified summary of new content added to the game.


Balance

Short Circuit Beam now affects tier 2 structures less, and tier 3 structures far less.
Chaos Engine can now be shot at a greater velocity.
Chaos Engine now does its actions more often.
Star Drive now drains its charge faster.



https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/cc50b1be0ff462e0948434d693c705c346f6d98f.jpg

Speaking of dreamy dates. It’s almost Valentine’s Day, and guess who likes you! We’re dying to know: will you be our Valentines? If the answer is yes, join us for a date tomorrow—February 14th, at 5pm EEST / 10am ET. Several people from our team will be online playing Worbital, so come to play with us. See you there!

Lastly, if you’ve played Worbital, make sure to leave us a Steam review!

notes.title: Worbital Status Update - Chugging Along
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/72a8f95c0636e87d378f0c4635676874c068715a.png
Hey, Worbitalists! It’s been about three weeks since Worbital beta 2 closed and since we announced the delay of the game’s full release. What have we been up to so far and how is Worbital doing? Let’s take a look together.

First things first: check out our new trailer above. This should be a worthy replacement for the currently outdated trailer on our Steam page and website. The new trailer was inspired by the awesome feedback we got from you during the beta run. Some of you might spot themselves in it…
https://youtu.be/_MjGaEdBtKs
Now, to the serious business. There are several things we’ve been focusing on over the past weeks. Here are some of the things we’ve been working on:
Network Functionality Improved 

We’ve fixed the bug that caused matches to be stuck in loading screen. Good to finally have that one out of the way. 
Improving AI 

The AI is learning day by day and becoming more fun to play with. It is now better at defending against super weapons, and it’s learned to steer itself when derailed. Soon it’ll outsmart all of us, just you wait.
Updated UI/UXI 

Some UI tweaks have been done across the board, making the playing experience more smooth. We’ve made some changes to the Main Menu, the Loadout menu and gameplay UI, making them overall more intuitive. 
Unlocking Weapons, Character and Planet CustomizationI 

We’ve been working on customization for the looks of advisor characters and player planets. Over the last weeks we’ve expanded the variety of outfits and planet skins. Space fashion show coming up?

Customization items and many of the weapons will be unlockable with the new unlock system. Basically, you earn points after every match and you can use those points to unlock extra weapons for your Battle Kit and other items.
More Weapons 

Of course, we’ve added MORE WEAPONS. Can there ever be enough? The new weapons include Cryogenesis, Dragon Missile, Flamethrower, Minefield, Burst Missiles and many others.

See some of those newest weapons demonstrated in the GIFs below.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/690aa2656708b9f63ca1c0241daaa509902a0e2d.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/214684e9df4a9649550c7ee68947107244856430.gif
Bug Fixing, Testing and Polish 

Above everything else, for the past weeks we’ve been occupied with bug fixing, polishing and testing the game. Polish is essential now that we are adding new features and weapons, to make sure they all work together well.

Polish and test-test-test. You might’ve spotted “Playing Worbital”-tag on some of the devs’ profiles. No need to feel jealous, we’re only testing the new stuff for you! And having tons of fun while doing it…
New Features 

Because our release had been delayed, parts of the team got time to work on a couple of completely new features which weren’t included in the original release plan. We don’t want to give away much yet, but let’s just say that there’s more than one star in the Worbital universe…

In other news: last week, some of us have been showcasing Worbital to gamedev peers from all over the world at the Montreal International Game Summit in Canada. That was probably the last public event we attended with Worbital this year, not that there’s much left of this year anymore.

These are all the news so far. Thank you for continuing to support Worbital during this break. We’ll be back with more news before the holidays. Until then, keep on worbing.

Blast you later!

notes.title: Worbital Beta Update #7 - Emotes, Build Limits & More
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/1250a7eb142485079534b6496b8924409856c470.jpg

Let’s go, beta update #7! This time we attempt to make things more social in Worbital and also to limit weapon spamming. Let us take a look.

Last week we added AI bots, so you could avoid playing with humans. But now it’s time to get more social. Worbital now has emotes! Emotes are scripted messages you can send to your playmates through your advisor character. You might not be able to share elaborate strategy plans, but you can have fun taunting. Or, you can apologize to your teammate for shooting them. This is a neat way for quick communication between players—simple enough to get a basic message across, but not so distracting as to pull you out of the heat of the game. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/8b97bedd5852577dd71caec85191a15c180e2df7.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/376acae386cfd19e2b4728cd65805bdb076adb03.png

Another issue we tackle in this update is weapons spamming. It is a common strategy to build one’s entire arsenal of just one weapon. Autocannon, Railgun, Nuclear Missile… This understandably can be frustrating to other players, but it’s been a legit strategy until now. Starting with this update, we have a structure limit imposed. It allows only a certain number of one weapon to be built at the same time. For instance, you can’t have more than 3 Lasers on your planet at once. Or more than 1 nuke… After testing this internally, we saw that the limit prompted more creative strategies and also made matches more dynamic.

Lastly, the robot invasion is expanding! It is now possible to add AI bots to Custom matches. Other additions include fixes and polish.

notes.title: Worbital Beta Update #4 - Gravity Magnets and Non-Gravity Plasma
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/2e73d5970e966d25645d440ab8811c2f344fbc7f.png

In this week’s beta update, we are adding several new weapons. Some of those affect gravity of objects around them, while others ignore gravity completely…

The main stars of this update are Magnet Gun and Gun Magnet. Both weapons shoot magnetic projectiles, which can mess with enemy projectiles when activated. Magnet Gun attracts projectiles, as expected. Gun Magnet, with its reversed polarity, repels projectiles.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/69ce6f77d7a67b56fbba9a34b0728c5f4f5b43c3.gif

Another gravity offender in this update is Gravimetric Shield - a defense structure that, basically, places a giant magnet on your planet’s surface, which repels all projectiles shot at that area.

And then there are those who don’t care much about gravity. Plasma Cannon fires a powerful shot of pure plasma. As we all know, plasma isn't affected by gravity and moves very slowly, so hitting your enemy with it is tricky, but worth it. You also can't adjust the shot's angle, same as with lasers, so the timing is everything.

Wave Cannon fires shockwaves, also unaffected by gravity. You can hold down the fire button to charge the shot and make it more powerful.

notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/096e47fdbd90a35ed97e3185e8758876ea5daf89.png

Here we are, the third beta update. This week, the solar system itself is getting more hostile, with asteroids and destructible sun…

Perhaps, things have been easy for you in Worbital. You master the resource management, all your shots are on target, your defenses always work on time. No challenge. Well, what if the solar system itself started bombarding you with massive rocks? With the new beta update, it inevitably will. Say hello to asteroids! As a match progresses, the asteroids will start moving from the asteroid belt surrounding the solar system towards its center, crashing into anything on their way. But if you keep an eye out, you can shield yourself against the asteroids or shoot them down - that will give you some bonus funds.

If that alone doesn’t spice things up for you, we are finally making it possible to destroy the sun. The sun can now be damaged by projectiles, asteroids, planetary collisions and such. Because of all the stray shots and an ever-increasing amount of asteroids in the solar system, the sun will eventually accumulate a lot of damage, and when it does, say goodbye to your soil and get ready for some cosmic whirlpool action!

Aside from asteroids and the black hole, we’ve also made some adjustments to the structure upgrade UI. Hopefully, those will make it easier for newcomers to figure things out. We also added a few fixes based on Discord community feedback.

notes.title: Worbital Beta Update #2 ,0.84.2696_Beta2 - World Rammer, USA Servers and More
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/17e49f0eebfab200c1905bad9d1c45fa7bf7fb3f.jpg

Phewh. Whaaat, another week went by already? It looks like the time has come for our next update. This week we are adding some interesting weapons you might’ve been waiting for…

The star of today’s update is, of course, World Rammer. We showed it in our beta trailer, and there were a lot of questions about it in the Discord community. So, here comes! As you might guess from the name, World Rammer is a superweapon that allows to ram planets off their orbits. This is the pillar of the cosmic chaos Worbital aims to spread! World Rammer is now available to Lucid and Celestials. Another new weapon this week is Earthshaker, added for Terrene and Celestials. Earthshaker deals damage to all the structures on the planet’s surface. A nice way to finish off a few enemy buildings in dire need of repair.

In addition, we are including some important fixes, that were initially included in last Friday’s reverted patch, as well as some new ones. They should make the game more stable and fix some bugs reported on Discord. 

Also, we no longer limit all players to the same EU server. Game lag has been an issue for some players in North America, so now we have a US server open to avoid that. The default server for everyone is still in EU, but you can now easily change that. In the game Options menu, select Network and pick either of the two available network regions - USA or EU.

Worbital Beta Update #2 ,0.84.2696_Beta2 - July 24th, 2018

Features

Added new structures for each faction

Terrene : Earthshaker
Celestial: Earthshaker, World Rammer
Lucid: World Rammer

Added USA server - Changeable through Options -> Network


Fixes

Nuclear Missiles and Steer Missiles being piloted when the player’s planet is destroyed should no longer cause the game to never end

notes.title: Worbital Beta Update #1, 0.83.2648_Beta2 - Loadout Edit and New Weapons
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33169128/f884add946e957f0b3bed5d967848157cd48620c.jpg

It’s been a week since we launched the Worbital public beta, so it’s a good moment to add more spice to it. Today we put out our first beta update!

At the beta launch, there was a set building loadout for each of the factions. With this update we add more structures, so, naturally, we add the loadout editing feature as well. You can now customize your loadout in the Battle Kit menu before a match.
Each of the factions got several new structures to build, which include: new power plants, new support structures, guns and defenses. Also, some of the old and familiar buildings are now available to more factions. For instance, Orbit Boost is now available for Terrene as well as the Celestials.

See the full changelog for the update:

Worbital Beta Update #1, 0.83.2648_Beta2 - July 18th, 2018

Features

Added new structures for each Faction

Terrene: Solar Plant, Big Shot, Autocannon, Orbit Boost
Lucid: Nuclear Plant, Big Shot, Fragmenter, Mining Probe
Celestials: Solar Plant, Defense Orbs, Homing Missile

It’s now possible to choose, edit and save Loadouts in the Battle Kit

Fixes

Queued games should no longer constantly get stuck during the loading screen

Games where a player disconnects during the loading screen may return the other players to the main menu instead of starting the game. A more permanent fix will be implemented in a future update.

Nuclear Missiles and Steer Missiles can now be piloted until their destruction even after the player has lost all their planets
Autocannon can no longer be activated unless it has at least one full activation charge
Orbit Boost should no longer occasionally boost the planet in the wrong direction
Planet Anchor now applies its slow effect properly when hitting a structure

Adjustments

Adjusted the movement and rotation speeds of moons and gas planets
Increased the amount of time it takes to automatically unlock Tier III
Increased Terrene and Celestial Refinery’s Funds generation at tech levels 1 and 2.
Increased the Lucid Refinery’s HP and adjusted the Funds generation to have less variance between different tech levels.
Decreased Laser’s HP and added a cooldown between activations
Decreased Colonizer’s, Evacuator’s and Terraformer’s HP
Decreased the uptime of Shield Defense
Moved some of Terrene Fragmenter’s damage from its fragments to the main projectile
Increased Defense Burster’s range and projectile size
Decreased Defense Burster’s damage and area of effect slightly
Autocannon now has a second charge at tech level 3
Evacuator now terraforms planets much faster
Decreased the uptime of Laser Blade
Increased Planet Anchor’s damage against structures
Increased Glacier’s freeze AoE at tech levels 1 and 2, but decreased its damage slightly



Overall, the beta has been going really great! Initially, we had humble expectations, but, to our surprise, we managed to gather over a thousand beta testers in the first week alone. Thanks to everyone who has joined and to everyone active on Discord. Worbital is already building up an active and friendly community, not to mention the useful feedback. We have already fixed some of the bugs and issues pointed out on Discord (see patches #1 & #2) and there are more fixes coming in this update.

We’re planning to put out another update soon. No major features, but we are adding a couple of real fun weapons. Hint: they will ram your mind away.

If you haven’t joined the Worbital beta yet, but would like to:

1. Join our official Discord server with this invite: https://discord.gg/kYYcrQu
2. Request a beta key by posting to Worbital #wrb_request-beta-key chat (mods will send the key to you as direct message)
3. Activate the received product key on Steam

Blast you later!
